ai_show_review.summary: Hard To Handle shines amid uneven Festival Express set
ai_show_review.blurb: The show delivers a spirited Hard To Handle and a quirky New Speedway Boogie cameo. Jerry and Phil keep the mood light with jokes, but the overall performance is uneven and the soundboard capture is only fair.
ai_show_review.review: On July 1, 1970 the Dead rolled into the Winnipeg Fairgrounds as part of the legendary Festival Express tour. The three‑song set opens with a rollicking cover of "Hard To Handle" that still manages to cut through an otherwise uneven evening, and a brief, off‑the‑cuff burst of "New Speedway Boogie" adds a fun novelty moment. Onstage Jerry and Phil were in a joking mood – reviewers called them “really really funny” – giving the concert a light‑hearted vibe even as the band’s tightness slipped in places. The soundboard source is only fair, offering just enough clarity to hear the occasional sparkle but lacking the polish of a true gem. For fans of the Festival Express era this tape is worth a spin for its unique setlist quirks and the occasional flash of classic Dead humor, though don’t expect a flawless performance.

best_recording.reason: Only available soundboard capture; despite fair quality it’s the most complete source of this show.
